description: social.md §12: hot (§12.1), post sorts magic/top/new/old/recentComments with the b ≤ 0 partition, forum pins and the magic-only cutoff (§12.2), list filters (§12.3), comment sorts with thread pins and Missing placeholders (§12.4), and Recent Discussion (§12.5). input: {fold: FoldInput, query: {posts: {sort, filter, kind?, author?}} | {comments: {thread, sort}} | {}}. expected: postOrder (listed post uris), hotBits ({post uri: 16 lowercase hex digits of the binary64 hot value} for each post in postOrder with b > 0, magic only), commentOrder (displayed node uris in pre-order), recentDiscussion ([{post, comments}]). hotBits come from Python's math.pow (hotBitsSource): compare within 1 ulp until the Rust side blesses exact bits; orderings are exact (testdata/vectors/README.md, social section). Generated by testdata/vectors/social-ref/gen_social.py from the reference model (testdata/vectors/social-ref/lessdugin_ref); do not edit by hand.

vectors.name: hot-bit-patterns-default-parameters
vectors.note: offsetHours 2, exponentMilli 1150, curatedBonus 10, frontpageBonus 0; ages are whole hours, so h is exact: b(alice) = 1 at 5 h, b(bob) = 1 + 1 = 2 at 8 h, b(carol) = 1 + 10 + 0 = 11 (curated) at 12 h, b(dave) = 1 + 2 = 3 at 27 h; hot = b / (h + 2)^1.15

vectors.name: hot-age-is-clamped-at-0
vectors.note: offsetHours = 1. alice's post claims a time 1 h after now (honest: its first-seen time is the same, so it is not future-dated and t_rank > now): age = max(now − t_rank, 0) = 0, base = 1 and hot = b / 1^1.15 = 1 exactly (bit pattern 3ff0000000000000)

vectors.name: hot-exponentMilli-1000
vectors.note: exponentMilli 1000: pow(base, 1.0) = base, so hot = b / (h + 2) uses only correctly rounded IEEE operations (ages here are not whole hours): b = 1 at 1.5 h, 3 at 4 h, 5 at 9 h 43 min

vectors.name: hot-exponentMilli-0-ignores-age
vectors.note: exponentMilli 0: pow(base, 0) = 1 and hot = b, so age plays no part among b > 0: bob and carol (b = 2) come first, in uri order (carol's 70-hour-old post is not behind bob's newer one), then alice and dave (b = 1), also in uri order

vectors.name: hot-curatedBonus-and-frontpageBonus
vectors.note: b(p) = score + (curated ? curatedBonus : 0) + (tier ≥ frontpage ? frontpageBonus : 0): personal alice 1; frontpage bob 1 − 2 = −1 (so b ≤ 0); curated carol 1 + 30 − 2 = 29 (curated is ≥ frontpage, so both bonuses apply)

vectors.name: b-le-0-partition
vectors.note: posts with b > 0 come first, by hot desc (bob's 1 h post with b = 1 before alice's 60 h post with b = 2); then b ≤ 0 by (b desc, t_rank desc): carol 0, dave −1 (3 h) before erin −1 (10 h), fred −3 last although newest

vectors.name: pinned-first
vectors.note: forum-pinned posts come first under magic, ordered among themselves by the same keys: bob's pinned post (b = 1, 70 days) before alice's (b = −2, 80 days, in the b ≤ 0 partition); then the unpinned posts by hot

vectors.name: uri-tie-break-magic
vectors.note: alice's and bob's posts have equal b = 1 and equal t_rank (3 h), so equal hot: uri asc decides (alice's DID sorts first); dave's and erin's tie in the b ≤ 0 partition (b = −1 at 5 h) and are also ordered by uri

vectors.name: uri-tie-break-new
vectors.note: the same posts under new: equal t_rank is ordered by uri asc

vectors.name: uri-tie-break-top
vectors.note: the same posts under top: equal (score, t_rank) is ordered by uri asc

vectors.name: cutoff-90-days-magic
vectors.note: now = T0 + 200 days, cutoffDays = 90: magic includes posts with now − t_rank ≤ 90 days (exactly 90 days is in, 90 days + 1 µs is out); top, new and old include every listed post

vectors.note: now = T0 + 200 days, cutoffDays = 90: magic includes posts with now − t_rank ≤ 90 days (exactly 90 days is in, 90 days + 1 µs is out); top, new and old include every listed post

vectors.note: now = T0 + 200 days, cutoffDays = 90: magic includes posts with now − t_rank ≤ 90 days (exactly 90 days is in, 90 days + 1 µs is out); top, new and old include every listed post

vectors.name: recent-discussion
